author: Kaory_
body:
Hey there boys, kinda wanna get back to old ocn gamemodes so here it is my lft :)

As a pvper, im really experienced, i'd consider myself like 9/10 in sword pvp, Im not bad using the bow since i havent used it in ages but xd
I know how to defend some ctw maps and my usual positions in old ocn were mid/sky
Timezone: im eu and i cant (usually) play evenings so id prefer an eu team
Ive got discord and ts
I was in some old ocn good teams, my communication is pretty good and im decently good as a leader
:)
